connections.title: Connected apps
connections.subtitle: AI assistants and other apps you allowed to use your account. They act as you, with your permissions, until you disconnect them.
connections.none: No apps are connected to your account.
connections.noneHint: Connect an AI assistant with the address below; it appears here once you allow it.
connections.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {name}? It loses access to your account at once; to use it again, connect it again.
connections.howBody: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other assistants that support MCP connectors can work in this app for you.
connections.step1: In your assistant, add a custom connector (MCP server) and paste this address.
connections.step2: Sign in here when it asks, and choose whether it may only read or also make changes.
connections.step3: It appears above; disconnect it whenever you like.
connections.off: Connecting AI assistants is turned off on this server. An administrator can turn it on (MCP_ENABLED).
